items.title: Child abuse reporting scheme sees hundreds of complaints in first weeks
items.description: The reportable scheme launched July 1, brought forward by 12 months, providing a consistent framework for reporting sexual offences, violence, and neglect.

items.title: Socceroos star allegedly tests positive for cocaine after speeding
items.description: Police say they stopped the 22-year-old in a BMW Coupe about 1am today and allege he was travelling 109 kilometres per hour on the Anzac Bridge.

items.title: Radical groups have a shared hatred of Jews, royal commission hears
items.description: The chief executive of a foundation combating antisemitism says extremist groups from across the political spectrum are posing an unprecedented threat to Australia's Jewish community.

items.title: Drivers urged not to panic buy as fuel price hikes nowhere near record high
items.description: Australians are being urged by a peak motorist association not to panic buy fuel amid a flare-up of tensions in the Middle East, saying prices are nowhere near April's record high.

items.title: Major report finds flaws in Australia's spy laws
items.description: A major review warns parts of Australia's national security laws could undermine democracy and press freedom.

items.title: TGA issues warning over rare eye disorder linked to Ozempic-like drugs
items.description: The Therapeutic Goods Administration has issued a safety warning for a rare, but serious risk of vision impairment from taking GLP-1-based drugs such as Ozempic and Wegovy.

items.title: Four Corners withdraws episodes by sacked reporter
items.description: The ABC has withdrawn the Four Corners programs Meth Highway and Cocaine Nation by sacked reporter Mahmood Fazal due to concerns about accuracy.

items.title: Australian government arguing 'very forcefully' against Trump's new 12.5pc tariffs
items.description: A new levy on exports from Australia into the US has taken effect, superseding the 10 per cent tariff that was expiring. Dozens of other countries have also been hit, but Australia's tariff is among the highest.

items.title: Live: Angus Taylor dismisses Trump's 'forced labour' tariff justification
items.description: Opposition Leader Angus Taylor says he's "dead against" the Trump administration's tariffs on Australian goods set to come into force later today, dismissing the notion it has anything to do with modern slavery laws. Follow live.

items.title: AI has changed what criminals can do with your stolen Origin data
items.description: The theft of names, addresses and phone numbers may seem less serious than stolen bank details, but cyber experts say AI is changing what criminals can do with that information.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
